name: Austin Fire Explorers Post 370
org: Austin Fire Department with Capitol Area Council, Scouting America
what_you_do: Learn basic firefighting, rescue and EMS skills from Austin firefighters. You get gear, train where real firefighters train, and compete in fire games in Rowlett and San Antonio.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 through 19. Co-ed. You do not need to be in top shape.
pay_detail: No pay or fee is stated on the page.
duration: Weekend meetings, one day each weekend for several weeks before each competition
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Fill out the interest card to get updates.
how_to_apply: Complete the Austin Fire Explorers Interest Card online to join the email list. Questions: firerecruiting@austintexas.gov.
notes: Competitions: DFW Fire Games in Rowlett in the spring and SAFD Explorers Fire Games in San Antonio in the fall. Being an Explorer does not affect a later Austin Fire cadet application. There are also volunteer chances.
